How the door really works (all four versions):
The calculator code only REVEALS the sign-in — it is a door knocker, not a password. Real security = your existing session login extended with a small members table (you + Johnny), plus middleware that gates every app page AND every /api/* route. The API gate is what actually stops strangers burning credits. The site also gets noindex so search engines forget it.

Every calculator here works — try the math, then try the unlock.

Two picks needed:
1) A direction (A, B, C or D)
2) The unlock gesture — typed code + '=' (A/B/C), tap-the-logo 5× (D), or both. '2468' is a SAMPLE code; the real one is set at build time and can be changed whenever.

Note: /login stays reachable by direct URL either way, so you and Johnny can bookmark it and skip the theater.
